message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout during dinner, and my kids were convinced it was the perfect time for a spontaneous campout in the living room! 😂 I grabbed our trusty flashlights and power bank to keep the phones charged while we shared stories and snacks in the glow. It reminded me that even in unexpected moments, a little preparedness can turn a hassle into a fun family memory. How do you keep the good vibes going during a power outage?
